name: Nek'mani Wellspring
summary: Naga guard Nek'mani Wellspring high above the Southern Savage Coast. Its fountain holds remarkably pure holy water, the only pristine fresh water south of Duskwood.

sections.title: A Sacred Basin
sections.body: Nek'mani Wellspring rises among the coastal heights of western Stranglethorn Vale. Scholars and pilgrims call its waters holy. Each culture claims the divine spring was blessed for its own people, and faiths still dispute whose claim is true. Now a vicious band of naga holds the basin and guards its water against all who approach.

faq.q: What makes the Nek'mani Wellspring special?
aliases: what is holy water of clarity
faq.answer: Nek'mani Wellspring yields remarkably pure holy water, the only pristine fresh water south of Duskwood. Religious scholars consider it divine, though faiths dispute which people it was meant for.

faq.q: Where exactly is the wellspring located?
faq.answer: Nek'mani Wellspring sits high on the cliffs overlooking the Southern Savage Coast, along Stranglethorn Vale's western shore.

faq.q: Who controls the Nek'mani Wellspring right now?
faq.answer: A hostile naga expedition has advanced inland from the ocean and claimed the sacred basin. The naga attack anyone who approaches the water.

faq.q: Why are adventurers sent to this spring?
faq.answer: Travelers and researchers seek the spring's holy water for enchantments, purifications, and alchemical mixtures that require pristine water.

angles.text: As a priest, you may find the claims of divine origin around Nek'mani Wellspring compelling. Scholars still dispute which faith its waters belong to.
